summary: Join our training course to understand the critical roles and responsibilities of directors and trustees. Equip yourself for effective leadership today!
lede: Director and trustee governance training helps board members understand oversight, delegation and management boundaries. It is for directors, trustees and professionals who prepare board information, and focuses on reviewing performance and risk without taking over executive work. Learners practise mapping decision rights, assessing risk registers, interpreting financial and strategy information, managing conflicts of interest and recording board decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who carry governance accountability or prepare the information, decisions, and controls that directors and trustees rely on. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured understanding of board duties and practical oversight methods.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite applies. Familiarity with organizational structures, board or committee meetings, management reports, or risk registers will help you contribute to exercises. You will use supplied case materials and templates, so you do not need to bring confidential organizational data. Legal duties vary according to the organization’s governing documents and applicable legal environment, and the course does not replace professional legal advice.
